Doosron ki rai mat suno, khud ki suno.
Soch lo: 'ho sakta hai' ya 'nahi'—dono mein se.
Khamoshi se mehnat karo, success shor machaye.
Aaj kuch aisa karo jiske liye future self tumhe thank you kahe.
Aage dekhke dots connect nahi hote; piche dekhke hi connection banta hai.
Intezar mat karo, sahi waqt kabhi nahi aata.
Jab koi believe na kare, tab khud pe believe.
Tumhari success tumhare mindset se decide hogi.
Jo measure hota hai, manage hota hai.
Apni zindagi ko aag banao. Unhe dhundo jo ise badhaye.
